example.title: Embassy Suites hotel, San Diego Bay (1988), 601 Pacific Highway
example.place: San Diego, San Diego County, CA

brief: A 1988 twelve-storey all-suite hotel: a tall cream-stucco slab with punched windows, a stepped upper storey with an arched parapet and a round sign roundel, a rounded corner wing of balconied rooms, and a two-storey arcaded base of shops and restaurants under green awnings along the boulevard, palms in front. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
